summary.ru: Данышмендиды — династия, основавшая в Анатолии между 1071 и 1085 годами эмират вокруг городов Токат, Амасья и Сивас. Династия правила эмиратом, а после его раздела — его частями. Ветви династии закончили своё правление в период с 1166 по 1178 год.
summary.en: The Danishmendids or Danishmends were a Turkish dynasty. These terms also refer to the Turkish state in Anatolia. It existed from 1071/1075 to 1178 and is also known as the Danishmendid Beylik. The dynasty was centered originally around Sivas, Tokat, and Niksar in central-northeastern Anatolia, and extended as far west as Ankara and Kastamonu for a time, and as far south as Malatya, which they captured in 1103. In the early 12th century, the Danishmends were rivals of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum, which controlled much of the territory surrounding the Danishmend lands, and they fought extensively against the Crusaders.
